text:
[Council File 26-1565]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE Board of Water and Power Commissioners (Board), General Exemption and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to authorizing the quitclaim of public water facility easement by Los Angeles Department of Water and Power to the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles, a Public Body Corporate and Politic.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. DETERMINE that the item is exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3). General Exemptions apply in situations where it can be seen with certainty that there is no possibility that the activity in question may have a significant effect on the environment. Therefore, the quitclaim of a Department of Water and Power (DWP) public utility easement is not an action subject to CEQA.
2. CONCUR with the Board action of October 27, 2026, Resolution No. 027-065, which approves quitclaim of public water facility easement by DWP to the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles, a Public Body Corporate and Politic DWP File No. JQ-224612.
3. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated October 30, 2026, approving Board Resolution No. 027 065 authorizing the quitclaim of public water facility easement by Los Angeles Department of Water and Power to the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles, a Public Body Corporate and Politic.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Energy and Environment Committee waived consideration of the above matter)
